description_en: Sets the weights of backend servers by calling SetBackendServers
description_zh: 调用SetBackendServers设置后端服务器权重
kebab_example: aliyun ens set-backend-servers --load-balancer-id lb-5s7crik3yo3bp03gqrbp50000 --backend-servers Type=ens ServerId=i-5ze0o05xccvbljtn0000 Ip=example-string Weight=20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetBackendServers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the backend server
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: 0 to 100.

If the value is 0, requests are not forwarded to the backend server
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器的权重。默认值：100，取值：0~100。

取值为0，表示不会将请求转发给该后端服务器
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en:
The server type of the backend server. Valid values:
ens: ENS instance.
eni: elastic network interfaces (ENIs) instance. An ENI is a network interface controller (NIC) bound to the instance
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
ens：ENS实例。
eni：弹性网卡实例
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of backend servers to add. You can modify up to 20 backend servers per call
parameters.help_zh: 添加的后端服务器列表，每次调用最多可修改20个后端服务器
parameters.name: backend_servers
